SUBJECT:
Contract Amendment #1 to Surface Transportation Urban Program Sub recipient
Agreement Between the Wyoming Department of Transportation(WYDOT)and
the City of Cheyenne(City Contract #6481).
Prairie Ave.&Frontier Mall Dr.Intersection Improvements Project
Please find the attached proposed contract amendment for the above referenced Sub recipient
Agreement.This amendment isforright-of-way acquisition services performed byWYDOT.
The cost increases include services for the review of legal exhibits outlining right-of-way
delineation roper ty appraisal, land purchase negotiation and acquisition, andWDOT's Indirt
Cost Allocation Plan(ICAP) increases.This additional work is required due to the reconfiguration
of the original intersection design.The reconfiguration extended the project footprint outside of
City right-of-way.The total amendment will increase the City's cost obligation toS241,118from
$229,269 (+$11,849). We respectfully request your approval of this contract amendment.
